implied_probability_note: Approximate win probability derived from the closing point spread with the existing logistic conversion (scale 19.5 points, fitted on 7,560 FBS games 2016-2025). Spreads are quoted at roughly equal prices on both sides; no moneyline prices or bookmaker margin (vig/fees) are used, so this is not a traded price, an executable quote or a share of bets or money.
license: Closing lines: one provider per game, provider named, used with written permission from CollegeFootballData.com for display on team and game pages. Not offered as a dataset or data feed.

model_total.reason: The incumbent model does not produce game totals, so no model-vs-market totals comparison is made.
